# 人工智慧探索應用學分學程

## 元智大學人工智慧探索應用學分學程科目規劃表
Yuan Ze University Applied Artificial Intelligence Exploration Program
Course Planning Table
115.04.29 一一四學年度第七次教務會議通過
Passed by the 7th Academic Affairs Meeting, Academic Year 2025, on April 29, 2026

### 一、教學目標 Teaching Objectives
為配合協助政府相關產業創新計畫，因應這波人工智慧革命，本學分學程屬於人工智慧應用學分學程，屬於學分學程內最容易入門的選項，主要給跨領域學生修習，因此課程設計從先修的程式設計和機率開始，透過循序漸進的修課規劃，讓學生除了有完備的人工智慧技術外，也了解相關倫理議題，最後透過人工智慧專題應用，讓學生們理解人工智慧技術在產業上落地的考量。
To support national industry innovation initiatives and respond to the ongoing AI revolution, this program—the Applied AI Exploration Program—is designed as the most accessible entry point within the TAICA credit programs. It is specifically intended for students from non-computing disciplines. The curriculum begins with foundational subjects such as programming and probability, then progresses gradually. Students not only gain solid technical knowledge in AI but also explore ethical considerations, and ultimately apply what they’ve learned through capstone AI application projects, which focus on real-world industry challenges.

### 三、學程證書授予標準 Certificate Award Criteria
有意修讀本學分學程的同學，請自行至個人Portal完成線上選課作業。 Students intending to apply for this credit program shall submit an online application through their personal Portal accounts.
凡修畢本學分學程規定課程並累計修滿15學分者，請向AI中心提出申請；經審核通過後，授予「人工智慧探索應用學分學程」證書。 Students who have accumulated 15 credits in this credit program may submit an application to the AI Center. Upon review and approval, a certificate for the Applied Artificial Intelligence Exploration Program will be awarded.
凡修畢AI聯盟開設課程的3門及其他院系開設課程2門者，累計達5門課程者，得申請教育部頒發的證書；欲申請者請向AI中心提出申請，經審核通過後將授予證書。 Students who have completed three courses offered by TAICA and two courses offered by other departments, for a total of five courses, may apply for a certificate issued by the Ministry of Education. Applicants shall submit their application to the AI Center; upon review and approval, the certificate will be awarded.
四、領域別 Fields of Study： 人工智慧 Artificial Intelligence
